name: Next Greater Element
description: For each element in an array, find the next greater element (first element to its right that is greater). Uses a monotonic decreasing stack for O(n) solution.
aim: Compute NGE[i] = nearest element to right of arr[i] that is greater than arr[i], or -1 if none exists, using a stack in O(n) time.
howItWorks: Initialize empty stack, result array with -1s
For each element right to left (or left to right with stack):
Pop elements from stack while top ≤ current element
If stack non-empty: result[i] = stack top (NGE found)
Result array has NGE for each index

time.bestCase: Linear — each element pushed and popped at most once

complexity.spaceDescription: Stack holds at most n elements in worst case (decreasing array)

realWorld: Stock span problem — days until price higher than today
whenToUse: Find next greater/smaller element in O(n)
When brute force O(n²) is too slow
alternatives: Brute force — O(n²), simple but slow
Binary search + sorted structure — O(n log n)
Segment tree — O(n log n) with range queries
